description:
Multiple modules implement nearly identical logic for extracting data from
benchmark result JSON files, with duplicated schema version detection and
field mapping. This creates maintenance burden and risk of inconsistent
behavior when the schema evolves.

Discovered during fix for empty chart generation (ResultPlotter._normalize_dict
was using v1.x schema paths while actual output uses v2.x schema).

The fix added v2.x support to result_plotter.py, but now there are 5+ places
with similar extraction logic that should be consolidated.
